verdict.rationale: Cloudflare does not ship a built-in AI-assistant panel inside the Workers dashboard, but it operates a fleet of managed remote MCP servers (mcp.cloudflare.com, docs.mcp.cloudflare.com, etc.) explicitly described as letting a user 'connect to Cloudflare's service from an MCP client (e.g. Cursor, Claude) and use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account,' plus an agent-setup hub wiring popular AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) directly to these servers, and probes confirm the servers are live and functional. This delivers 'delegate tasks to an assistant that operates inside the product's ecosystem' but only via external AI clients, not a first-party assistant embedded in the product UI itself. Missing for 10: a native in-dashboard chat/assistant UI, and independent hands-on evidence of successfully delegating multi-step account tasks end-to-end.
